VOICE / NATIVE APPLICATIONS

Connect a native interface to realtime AI.

A voice-assistant architecture spanning Apple clients and a Python backend, with the public overview focused on engineering scope.

ProjectMaxBob AI
ScopePrivate implementation · public overview
StackSwiftUI · Swift · WebRTC · Python

The problem

A native voice assistant combines an interface, realtime audio transport, model integration and platform capabilities. Those parts must work together across the client and backend rather than ending at a chat screen.

My contribution

  • Developed native SwiftUI interfaces across Apple platforms.
  • Connected realtime voice over WebRTC to a Python backend.
  • Worked on Apple integrations including reminders, shortcuts, music and cross-device synchronization.

How the system works

Native interfaceRealtime audioPython backendAI responsePlatform integration

Use a native client layer. SwiftUI provides the interface and the integration point for Apple-platform capabilities.

Separate audio transport from application logic. WebRTC carries realtime audio while the backend coordinates the AI-facing application flow.

Connect to platform workflows. Reminders, shortcuts, music and synchronization connect the assistant to capabilities of the Apple clients.

What you can verify

The project brings together native interfaces, voice transport, backend integration and platform workflows. The public project website and this overview are available; implementation details can be discussed directly.
